name: blueprint/budget-guard
description: A personal budget with an LLM categorizer: expense receipts in the store, rh_text_classify sorts each one into your categories, the cap lives in rh_store (NOT settings - the schema wall), and rh_notify_send warns before the cap, not after.
use_cases: log an expense with a category
warn me at 80 percent of the cap
ingredients: rh_store_put expense:<ts> { amount, category, note } and budget:cap { value }
rh_store_list + rh_store_get for the window sum
recipe: log: rh_store_put expense:<ts> { amount, note } -> categorize: rh_text_classify { text: note, labels: [food, transport, home, other] } -> overwrite with the category -> sum: scan expense:* for the window and add amounts -> cap: read budget:cap from the STORE (unregistered settings keys vanish - live-verified) -> warn: at 80 percent, rh_notify_send once (record the sent warning so it is not repeated)
result_kind: dated expense records + one cap record + one warning per threshold crossing
cost_hint: one model call per uncategorized expense; everything else free
pitfalls: keep the cap in rh_store, not rh_settings: set accepted an unregistered key and get never returned it (live-verified schema wall)
classify answers with a label VERBATIM from the set - anything else is an error
sums are a scan: list the window prefix and add - there is no query language
warn-once needs its own record (budget:warned:<ts>) or every turn re-warns
amounts as numbers, categories as strings - JSON-serializable only
local_limits: no real currency conversion - amounts are whatever unit you log
cloud_limits: a markets adapter (keyless rates) is the documented escalation for multi-currency
